facts.text: A manufacturer of heavy off-road machines is developing a Collision Mitigation System that brakes automatically when the operator does not react to a proximity warning.
facts.quote: A manufacturer of heavy off-road machines is developing a Collision Mitigation System that brakes automatically when the operator does not react to a proximity warning.

facts.text: The manufacturer's Collision Mitigation System prototype hardware and software are due to arrive in mid-2027.
facts.quote: Prototype hardware and software arrive in mid-2027

facts.text: Validation of the manufacturer's Collision Mitigation System must be finished in less than four months after prototype hardware and software arrive in mid-2027.
facts.quote: Prototype hardware and software arrive in mid-2027, and validation must be finished in less than four months after that.

facts.text: The manufacturer's last function comparable to the Collision Mitigation System took three to four years to validate.
facts.quote: The last comparable function took three to four years to validate

facts.text: Validation of the manufacturer's last function comparable to the Collision Mitigation System relied mostly on physical testing and tuning on each machine model.
facts.quote: The last comparable function took three to four years to validate, mostly through physical testing and tuning on each machine model.

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine manufacturer wants a strategy and roadmap for conducting most Collision Mitigation System validation virtually.
facts.quote: The manufacturer wants a strategy and roadmap for doing most of that validation virtually.

facts.text: The research supporting the manufacturer's virtual-validation strategy used no internal data: no machine recordings, site video, sensor specifications or internal documents.
facts.quote: It contains no internal data: no machine recordings, site video, sensor specifications or internal documents were used.

facts.text: The manufacturer's sensor types, machine types, software maturity and existing recordings were unavailable when the virtual-validation research was conducted and were therefore treated as unknown.
facts.quote: The manufacturer's own facts (sensor types, machine types, software maturity, existing recordings) were not available when the research was done
